one_line_thesis: Essential financial intelligence — ratings, indices, and data subscriptions — a Stahl croupier / index infrastructure compounder with extraordinary margins; earnings leverage to issuance and AUM with cyclicality at the margin.

deep_dive.executive_summary: S&P Global is index and ratings infrastructure: fees on debt issuance, benchmark tracking, and data subscriptions with extraordinary margins. FY2025 filings confirm $15,336M revenue, $6,478M operating income, $4,471M net income, and $31,127M stockholders' equity; Q1 2026 revenue $4,171M (+10% YoY) with operating income $2,002M (+27% YoY) and diluted EPS $4.69 (+33% YoY). Mobility spin mid-2026 should simplify the portfolio toward core toll booths. At ~$411, Lawrence base case implies ~10.1% annualized return over 7 years on ~$17.5 mid-cycle FCF per share, below the 15% hold band. Bear case ...
